Acceptance packet complete. All five ACs met (workflow wiring, changed-path detection, Cloud Build registry, GCS manifest, service-ID alignment). Both upstream deps (BP5-CICD-001, BP5-SVC-016) confirmed done. Five open questions logged (OQ-1 to OQ-5) for parent-task owner. No canonical files modified. Please review and approve.

Review requested changes: the packet says BP5-CICD-002 has no explicit acceptance criteria, but the archived task snapshot includes two acceptance entries. It also states a 20-service / parallel Cloud Build inventory, while cloudbuild.yaml defines 17 DOCKERFILES entries and builds them serially in one loop. Reconcile the manifest-bucket dependency note (BP5-GCP-001 vs BP5-GCP-002) against source evidence, then re-handoff for review.

Packet revised (rev 2). Three Codex review findings addressed: (1) two canonical ACs from archived snapshot are now prominently cited and the five derived checks map to them; (2) delivery inventory corrected to 17-service serial build loop (was 20-service parallel claim); (3) GCS manifest bucket dependency corrected to BP5-GCP-001 throughout (AC-4, downstream table, Section 6) per cloudbuild.yaml source evidence. No canonical files modified. Please review and approve.

Review requested changes: the packet still claims Stage 0 changed-path/build-target alignment for bff, governance-api, telemetry-ingest, and runtime-manager, but .github/pantheon-stage0-matrix.json gives those targets no build block and scripts/ci_stage0.py only emits build_ids for targets with build. Reconcile AC-3, AC-5, and Section 6 with source evidence: either mark this as a routing gap / manual-or-global-only path, or narrow the alignment claim to the true matrix build targets before re-handoff.

Packet revised (rev 3). Codex rev-2 routing-gap finding fully addressed: (1) AC-2 now correctly notes that gcp-deploy.yml consumes build_ids only, and bff/governance-api/telemetry-ingest/runtime-manager have verify-only blocks in pantheon-stage0-matrix.json so they are absent from build_ids on targeted path pushes; (2) AC-3 Notes corrected to distinguish build-aligned services (router, persona, research, lean) from verify-only services with routing gap; (3) AC-5 completely rewritten with split alignment tables — fully-aligned group and routing-gap group — all backed by source evidence from ci_stage0.py line 196 and gcp-deploy.yml detect step; (4) OQ-6 added for owner to decide whether to add build blocks to Stage 0 matrix; (5) Section 6 updated with routing-gap note on AC-A and routing gap summary. No canonical files modified. Please review and approve.

Review changes requested. See support/sidecars/BP5-CICD-002/BP5-CICD-002-SIDECAR-ACCEPTANCE-REVIEW.md: (1) AC-3 cites the wrong runtime-manager Dockerfile evidence path; actual Dockerfile is services/runtime-manager/Dockerfile, not services/execution/runtime-manager/. (2) AC-5 contradicts itself by calling incidents/postmortems absent from cloudbuild.yaml and then claiming no phantom IDs, even though both are manual-only IDs present only in cloudbuild.yaml. Please revise the packet and re-handoff for review.

Packet revised (rev 4). Both Codex rev-3 blocking findings addressed: (1) AC-3 runtime-manager Dockerfile evidence path corrected from services/execution/runtime-manager/ to services/runtime-manager/Dockerfile (verified against cloudbuild.yaml line 101 and file system); (2) AC-5 third table split into two distinct groups — 'in-matrix/no-Dockerfile services correctly absent from cloudbuild.yaml' (runtime-control, feedback, lineage-read, signal-store, web, cron) and 'manual-only targets in cloudbuild.yaml but absent from Stage 0 matrix' (incidents, postmortems) — closing summary sentence updated to clarify incidents/postmortems are intentional manual-only targets, not unintentional phantom IDs. No canonical files modified. Please review and approve.
